name: StarCraft II: Campaign Collection
summary:
The fate of your people rests in your hands, commander. Lead your forces to ultimate victory across the far-flung battlefields of the future, or reap defeat and devastation at the hands of terrifying, alien foes.

StarCraft II is the pinnacle of real-time strategy gaming. Challenge your cunning, tactical thinking, and unbreakable will as you command three unique armies in intense conflicts across the stars.

● Master the art of war as the ever-adaptable Terrans, who rely on mechanized infantry and rugged, versatile tech to take on whatever the universe throws at them.
● Devour your enemies as the unstoppable Zerg swarm, whose ravenous hunger to consume, evolve, and dominate makes them a terrifying threat.
● Wield power overwhelming as the enigmatic Protoss, an elder race of psionic warriors with a frightful edge thanks to their advanced technology and alien mysticism.

The Campaign Collection includes the complete story of StarCraft II, an epic space opera spanning three massive campaigns that will put your leadership skills to the test and task you with growing your forces as the plot unfolds.
